title: The Gallic War
subtitle: Caesar's own account of the conquest of Gaul
author: Gaius Julius Caesar
source: library/julius-caesar/gallic-war-1.md … gallic-war-8.md in Amenti.live · trans. McDevitte & Bohn (1869) · Project Gutenberg #10657 · public domain
note: Eight books in twenty-two parts. Caesar narrates his own commentaries and speaks his own speeches; the Gauls and Germans who speak at length are cast from the ledger. Book VIII was written after Caesar by his officer Aulus Hirtius; Caesar's voice carries it on. Attributions are in REVIEW.md.
